titel: Development of new cleaning technology, sterilization and surface functionalization of materials
ziel: Project's aim is to develop a new system for surface functionalization of materials based on low temperature atmospheric discharges. Unlike other systems, the system will use not only the classical gas leading to oxidation but also inlet for dosing precursor vapor allowing grafting besides other conventional hydroxyl groups also functional groups, e.g. carboxyl or based on SiOx. The system will ensure greater efficiency and speed of surface functionalization for subsequent processing eg. gluing or painting. Another application is perfect for cleaning metal.
